definitions.explanation: Describes something that is unnecessarily complex, hard to understand, or bothersome to deal with. Often implies annoyance.

examples.japanese: この{手続|てつづ}きはややこしい。
ややこしい{話|はなし}になってきた。
examples.english: This has become a complicated matter.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}との{関係|かんけい}はややこしいんだ。
examples.english: My relationship with him is complicated.

notes:
FORMS:
・ややこしく (adverb) - complicatedly
・ややこしさ (noun) - complication, complexity

USAGE:
ややこしい has a slightly colloquial feel and often implies frustration or annoyance with unnecessary complexity. It's commonly used in Kansai dialect but is understood nationwide.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ややこしい{話|はなし} (complicated matter)
・ややこしい{手続|てつづ}き (complicated procedure)
・ややこしい{問題|もんだい} (complicated problem)
・ややこしくなる (to become complicated)

REGISTER:
Casual to neutral. Common in everyday speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{複雑|ふくざつ} - complex (neutral, more formal)
・{面倒|めんどう} - troublesome (focuses on the bother)
・ごちゃごちゃした - messy/jumbled (more visual)
・{分|わ}かりにくい - hard to understand (focus on comprehension)

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: ややこしくなかったら
